title: UN Commission finding on cultural destruction and self-determination
summary: The Commission assessed the combined effect of attacks on education, cultural and religious sites on Palestinian collective identity and self-determination.
claim: The Commission concluded on reasonable grounds that destruction of education and cultural and religious sites, restrictions on access and erasure of heterogeneous history violated the Palestinian people's right to self-determination.
legal_characterization: International-law finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 97 of A/HRC/59/26. The record preserves the Commission's reasonable-grounds wording and does not present the conclusion as a court judgment or extend it beyond the report's stated scope.
